asset_issues.detail: The prompt names a CloudFront MP4 in the video specification and a Mux HLS URL in assembly. The original MP4 is hosted locally and used as primary; Mux is retained as an emergency fallback.
Three Chromium media requests were canceled with net::ERR_ABORTED during StrictMode cleanup/media reinitialization. Playback readiness and forward/backward seeking passed. No asset download failed.
Google Fonts loaded successfully during verification but requires external connectivity. The HLS emergency fallback and Safari native HLS were not exercised.

notes: Only this project was read and written. No agents, provider sessions, deployment, push, or external messages were created.
All requested stack dependencies are installed and locked. React 19, BrowserRouter, StrictMode, Tailwind v4 Vite plugin, GSAP ScrollTrigger/ScrollToPlugin, and hls.js are implemented.
Original downloaded film: approximately 20.2 MiB, 6.041667 seconds. Original Dirtyline WOFF2 is included locally.
At 390px the exact specified minimum 4rem headline font allows the first logical line to wrap at its word boundary.
SERVICES and CONTACT use the supplied About destination because the prompt defines no additional sections or actions.
Vite build passes with a nonfatal JavaScript chunk-size advisory (984.58 kB, 320.14 kB gzip).
Detailed browser evidence: screenshots/browser-checks.json. Run instructions and limitations: README.md.
ready means ready for acceptance; no deployment has occurred.
